```{r}
#pl lvl 700 joins by GEOID
library(alarmdata)
library(redist)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggredist)
library(patchwork)


map_MO <- alarm_50state_map('MO')
map_MO <- map_MO |>
  mutate(vote_tot = nrv + ndv)

map_MO2 <- redist_map(map_MO, existing_plan = cd_2020, pop_tol = 0.01, total_pop = pop, adj = map_MO$adj)

MO_plans <- redist_smc(map_MO2, nsims = 20)


MO_plans = MO_plans |>
    mutate(comp = comp_polsby(pl(), map_MO2),
            pop_dev = plan_parity(map_MO2),
           rep_vote = group_frac(map_MO2, nrv, vote_tot),
           dem_vote = group_frac(map_MO2, ndv, vote_tot))

```



```{r}
plan_summary <- MO_plans |>
  group_by(draw) |>
  summarise(
    mean_comp   = mean(comp,      na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dem    = mean(dem_vote, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rep    = mean(rep_vote, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pop_dev = max(abs(pop_dev), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_competitiveness = mean(
      pmin(abs(dem_vote - 0.5), abs(rep_vote - 0.5)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    )


plan_summary <- plan_summary |>
  mutate(
    score_comp  = (mean_comp   - min(mean_comp)) / diff(range(mean_comp)),
    score_dev   = 1 - (max_pop_dev - min(max_pop_dev)) / diff(range(max_pop_dev)),
    score_dem   = (mean_dem    - min(mean_dem))    / diff(range(mean_dem)),
    score_rep   = (mean_rep    - min(mean_rep))    / diff(range(mean_rep)),
    score_compete = 1 - (mean_competitiveness - min(mean_competitiveness)) /
                        diff(range(mean_competitiveness)),

    total_score = (0.3 * score_comp) + (0.1 * score_dev) + (0.6 * score_compete)) |>
  arrange(desc(total_score)) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number())


print(plan_summary |> select(rank, draw, mean_comp, max_pop_dev, mean_dem, mean_rep, total_score))

```





```{r}
top_draws <- plan_summary |>
  filter(draw != "cd_2020") |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  pull(draw)

redist.plot.plans(MO_plans,
  draws = c("cd_2020", as.character(top_draws)),
  shp   = map_MO2)

```




```{r}

#finds republican districts count

MO_plans <- MO_plans |> 
mutate(rep_district = rep_vote > 0.51)


rep_counts <- MO_plans |>
  group_by(draw) |>
  summarise(
    mean_comp       = mean(comp,         na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pop_dev     = max(abs(pop_dev),  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rep_districts = sum(rep_district),
    mean_rep_vote   = mean(rep_vote,     na.rm = TRUE),  # avg R share across districts
    max_rep_vote    = max(rep_vote,      na.rm = TRUE),  # strongest R district
    min_rep_vote    = min(rep_vote,      na.rm = TRUE),  # weakest R district
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_rep_districts))

```





```{r}
max_rep <- max(rep_counts$n_rep_districts)

best_plans <- rep_counts |>
  filter(n_rep_districts == max_rep)
```




```{r}

#graphs top districts

#broken rn 

plot_draws <- c("cd_2020", as.character(best_plans$draw))

redist.plot.plans(MO_plans,
  draws = c("cd_2020", as.character(best_plans)),
  shp   = map_MO2)
```


```{r}

#ranks redistricts

best_plans <- best_plans |>
  mutate(
    score_comp  = (mean_comp   - min(mean_comp)) / diff(range(mean_comp)),
    score_dev   = 1 - (max_pop_dev - min(max_pop_dev)) / diff(range(max_pop_dev)),
    total_score = (0.7 * score_comp) + (0.3 * score_dev)) |>
  arrange(desc(total_score)) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number())


best <- best_plans |>
  filter(rank == 1) |>
  pull(draw) |>
  as.character()


print(best_plans |> select(rank, draw, mean_comp, max_pop_dev, total_score))
```


```{r}
#map dem and reps
redist.plot.plans(MO_plans,
                  draws = best,
                  shp   = map_MO2,
                  qty   = dem_vote) +
  scale_fill_party_c(midpoint = 0.50) +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Best Gerrymandered Plan: Draw", best),
    subtitle = paste0(max_rep, " Republican districts | Score: ", 
                      round(best_plans$total_score[1], 3)),
    fill     = "Rep. Vote Share"
  )
```





```{r}

  
my_cutpoints <- c(0, .35, .45, .49999, .5, .50001, .55, .65, 1.00)
my_labels    <- c("R+15 or more", "R+5 to R+15", "R+1 to R+5", "R+0 to R+1",
                  "D+0 to D+1",  "D+1 to D+5",  "D+5 to D+15","D+15 or more")
my_colors    <- c("#b2182b","#d6604d","#f4a582","#fddbc7",
                  "#d1e5f0","#92c5de","#4393c3","#2166ac")

redblue <- MO_plans |>
    mutate(margin = factor(
        cut(dem_vote, breaks = my_cutpoints, labels = my_labels),
        levels = my_labels))
  
  
redist.plot.plans(redblue,
                  draws = best,
                  shp   = map_MO2,
                  qty   = margin) +         
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = setNames(my_colors, my_labels),
    drop   = FALSE                          
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Best Gerrymandered Plan: Draw", best),
    subtitle = paste0(max_rep, " Republican districts | Score: ",
                      round(best_plans$total_score[1], 3)),
    fill     = "Vote Margin"
  )

```
